definitions.body_yaw: Vehicle yaw-label heading-envelope proxy only; not decoder displacement heading or a proof of XY impossibility.
definitions.decoder_initial_speed: clamped longitudinal vx, not planar speed
definitions.denominators: All warmup/driving camera anchors retained; tail anchors context only; overlapping windows are not independent maneuvers.
definitions.native_gaps: A horizon becomes an unavailable contiguous prefix at any missing/off-grid native20Hz interval; exact100ms endpoints do not override source incompleteness.
definitions.not_solved: Route-relative slip/reachability, physical reference-point identity, content realism, safety and dataset admission.
definitions.speed_label: Endpoint measured planar velocity; differs from XY interval-average speed.
definitions.stationary_heading: Steps <=0.0001m remain unassessed by the unchanged heading diagnostic, not counted as passing.
definitions.xy_bounds: Necessary discrete speed/acceleration/curvature/lateral bounds with initial path heading zero, not sufficient reachability.

capture_error: CollectionError: comfortable goal-stop measured quality failed; preserve partial evidence
limitation: Nine necessary discrete future bounds and source/ACK checks are reported; no threshold is weakened and none constitutes dataset admission.

bounds.notice: Speed-rate checks alone do not establish complete decoder or runtime feasibility.

camera_frame_coverage.policy: Every second recorded native state starting with the first state, exactly as the collector schedules cameras.

original_scalar_quality.interval_phase_policy: Assign each interval to its destination phase, retaining the previous-phase prefix state.
original_scalar_quality.notice: Measured scalar speed-rate QA only; no learned actuation, target clipping, full runtime validation, or decoder feasibility guarantee.
original_scalar_quality.speed_definition: hypot(measured base_link vx, measured base_link vy); finite difference over actual timestamps
